purpose: Determine without refitting whether the remaining V63 development failure is caused by training a Gauss-Hermite distribution expectation while deploying a finite frozen empirical-rank transport, and whether the sampler-aligned tail correction is locally compatible with the train-only sub-Mpc density-pair error.

frozen_empirical_rank_ensemble.donor_index_and_signed_cube_isometry: draw sequentially with numpy default_rng(164064); donor index is uniform over the immutable donor-domain train objects and is advanced by one modulo the domain count if it equals query object zero in the same domain; isometry is uniform over the frozen 48 signed cube isometries
frozen_empirical_rank_ensemble.rank_construction: apply the frozen V31 conditional_forward transform to donor target-minus-backbone conditioned on donor backbone, followed by the selected signed cube isometry

sampler_aligned_tail_candidate.parameters: unchanged V63 step-12000 EMA query-local bounded-mixture parameters on the fixed train query
sampler_aligned_tail_candidate.sampler: same-voxel differentiable bounded-mixture inverse CDF evaluated at the 16 frozen train-only empirical conditional-rank fields
sampler_aligned_tail_candidate.mask: the identical physical-backbone-plus-target-mean q99.9 mask used by the V63 objective
sampler_aligned_tail_candidate.predicted_moment: mean of (exp(4.5 ln(10) y)-1)^2 across the selected voxels and 16 empirical-rank members
sampler_aligned_tail_candidate.truth_moment: exact target mean of (exp(4.5 ln(10) y)-1)^2 across the identical query mask
sampler_aligned_tail_candidate.score: source-balanced mean of 0.5 times squared ln(predicted moment divided by truth moment)
sampler_aligned_tail_candidate.control: the existing 64-point Gauss-Hermite V63 conditional moment and score on the same parameters, targets, backbones, and masks
sampler_aligned_tail_candidate.member_stability_control: compare the first 8 frozen members against all 16; this measures finite-rank stability rather than quadrature convergence

train_only_sub_mpc_compatibility_diagnos.anchor_coordinates: uniform without replacement from the interior coordinates [3,60]^3
train_only_sub_mpc_compatibility_diagnos.offset_direction: cycle deterministically over positive and negative x, y, and z directions while remaining inside the cube
train_only_sub_mpc_compatibility_diagnos.statistic: for each separation, empirical-rank ensemble mean of delta(x) delta(x+r) compared with the exact train target pair mean
train_only_sub_mpc_compatibility_diagnos.score: source-and-separation-balanced mean of 0.5 times squared ln(predicted positive pair mean divided by truth positive pair mean)
train_only_sub_mpc_compatibility_diagnos.gradient_compatibility: cosine between the sampler-aligned tail-score output gradient and the sub-Mpc pair-score output gradient; positive cosine means a local tail descent also reduces the pair score

required_measurements: domainwise Gauss-Hermite, empirical-rank-8, empirical-rank-16, and exact target q99.9 moments and ratios
domainwise empirical-rank versus Gauss-Hermite log-moment discrepancy
bounded-NLL, retained V63 score, sampler-aligned tail score, and sub-Mpc pair-score output-gradient L2 and maximum absolute values
tail-to-pair output-gradient cosine and dot product
rank multiset digests, donor mapping, selected counts, finite values, and inverse-CDF bounds
peak Ada allocation and all frozen artifact hashes and canonical decision digests

selection_rules.material_sampler_mismatch: absolute empirical-rank-16 versus Gauss-Hermite log moment ratio is at least ln(1.1) in any domain
selection_rules.optimization_relevant_tail_gradient: sampler-aligned tail output-gradient L2 divided by bounded-NLL output-gradient L2 is in [0.01,100]
selection_rules.finite_rank_stability: empirical-rank first-8 versus all-16 moment relative difference is at most 0.5 in every domain
selection_rules.pair_conflict: the sub-Mpc pair score is nonzero with an optimization-relevant finite gradient and tail-to-pair gradient cosine is negative
selection_rules.select_sampler_aligned_tail_model: material sampler mismatch, optimization-relevant tail gradient, finite-rank stability, finite total gradients, memory pass, and no pair conflict
selection_rules.select_copula_or_joint_structure_audit_i: pair conflict holds or sampler mismatch is not material despite the sealed development morphology failure
selection_rules.no_candidate_selected: numerical, gradient-scale, ancestry, memory, or firewall checks fail
